scripts.dev: concurrently -n emulators,frontend -c cyan,magenta "npm run emulators" "npm run dev:frontend"
scripts.emulators: npm --prefix functions run build && firebase emulators:start --project demo-genesis
scripts.build: npm --prefix functions run build && npm --prefix frontend run build
scripts.typecheck: npm --prefix functions run typecheck && npm --prefix frontend run typecheck
scripts.lint: npm --prefix functions run lint && npm --prefix frontend run lint
scripts.test:unit: npm --prefix functions run test && npm --prefix frontend run test
scripts.test:rules: firebase emulators:exec --project demo-genesis --only firestore "vitest run --config tests/rules/vitest.config.mts"
scripts.test: npm run typecheck && npm run lint && npm run test:unit && npm run test:rules
scripts.install:all: npm install && npm --prefix frontend install && npm --prefix functions install
